en: And the grief incident to my not seeing you shall burn me greatly, even, O monkey, as grief burn one that is already consumed by sorrow over and over again.

sa: भृत्या मे सुभृतास्तात दीनश्चाभ्युद्धतो जनः॥ नोत्सहेऽद्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ पाण्डवान् वक्तुमीदृशम्।
en: My servants have all been well cared for by me. I have relieved people in distress. I dare not, O foremost of men, speak such humble words to the Pandavas.

sa: यदास्यान्महती सेना हयनागरथाकुला। पदातियन्त्रबहुला अनुरक्ता षडगिनी॥ यदा बहुविधां वृद्धिं मन्येत प्रतिलोमतः। तदा विवृत्य प्रहरेद् दस्यूनामविचारयन्॥
en: When a king happens to have a large army consisting of sixfold forces and enough of horse, elephant, cars, foot, and engines, all devoted to him, when he thinks himself superior to his enemies in many respects upon a fair comparison, then should he openly strike the enemy without hesitation.

sa: ततस्ते पामकर्माणो लोभोपहतचेतसः। आभीरा मन्त्रयामासुः समेत्याशुभदर्शनाः॥
en: Then those sinful wretches, with hearts possessed by cupidity, viz., those Abhiras of ill omen, assembled together and held consultation.

sa: दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि कौन्तेय सहामात्यो युधिष्ठिर। परिवृत्तो हि भगवान् सहस्रांशुर्दिवाकरः॥
en: By good luck, O son of Kunti, you have come here with all your counsellors, O Yudhishthira. The thousandrayed maker of day, the holy Sun, has begun his northward course.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा देवराजस्य कश्यपोऽथ प्रजापतिः। वालखिल्यानुपागम्य कर्मसिद्धिमपृच्छत॥
en: Prajapati Kashyapa, having heard every thing from Indra, went to the Valakhilyas and asked whether their act had been successful.

sa: शक्रस्तु वीर्यसदृशमिध्मभारं गिरिप्रभम्। समुद्यम्यानयामास नातिकृच्छादिव प्रभुः॥
en: And Lord Indra, taking up according to his great strength a weight which was mountainlike, brought it without any fatigue.

sa: नामभिः कीर्तितैस्तस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः। पृष्टवान् केशवं राजन् फाल्गुनः परवीरहा॥
en: That killer of hostile heroes, viz., Phalguna, had at one time asked Keshava, enquiring after the meanings of the some of the names by which the great Keshava is worshipped.

sa: महाभूतविनाशान्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते। सर्वप्राणभृतां धीरा महदुत्पद्यते भयम्॥ स धीरः सर्वलोकेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति।
en: When at the close of the destruction of the grcat elements, the dissolution of the universe comes, O wisemen, a great fear possesses all living creatures. However, the man with self realisation and bold enough remains undeviated to that circumstances.

sa: हीनवर्णो नृपश्रेष्ठ तप्यते सुमहत्तपः। भविष्यच्छूद्रयोन्यां हि तपश्चर्या कलौ युगे॥
en: O foremost of men, the degraded caste, the Śūdras, during your rege me, have engaged in austere penances. And in the Kali Yuga asceticism shall be established in the Sūdras.

sa: आप्लवन्तो हरिवराः सर्वतस्तं महागिरिम्। मृगमार्जारशार्दूलांस्त्रासयन्तो ययुस्तदा॥
en: Those best of monkeys, springing all around that mighty hill, proceeded terrifying the deer, the wild cats and the tigers.

sa: एवमाधावमानं तु नातिक्रुद्धः शचीपतिः। हस्तान्तादतिमुक्तेन कुलिशेनाभ्यताडयत्॥
en: But not greatly enraged the thousand-eyed lord of Saci, with the thunder bolt in his hand, struck the running Hanumān.

sa: इन्द्रमाशंसमानस्तु त्रातारं सिंहिकासुतः। इन्द्र इन्द्रेति संत्रासान्मुहुर्मुहुरभाषत।॥
en: And considering Indra as the saviour the son of Simhikā, stricken with fear, again and again cried aloud "Indra! Indra!!"

sa: एवं चेद्धर्मवृद्धिश्च नृणां चायुर्विवर्धनम्। भविष्यति नरश्रेष्ठ बालस्यास्य च जीवितम्॥
en: And by that, O foremost of men, the piety of the subjects shall be increased, the lease of their life shall be prolonged and this boy shall regain his life.

sa: नैष योग्योऽद्य मित्रं वा शत्रुर्वा पुरुषाधमः॥ किमनेनातिभुग्नेन वाग्भिः काष्ठसधर्मणा।
en: This wretch is not to be regarded either as a friend or an enemy! What use in using harsh words to him who has now become a piece of wood.

sa: अन्योन्यं चापि संरब्धौ विचेस्तुरमर्षणौ। कृतास्त्रौ निशितैर्बाणैरसिशक्तिगदाभृतौ॥
en: They discharged arrows quickly like clouds pouring torrents of rain. Enraged with each other the (two) wrathful (heroes) moved about,

sa: अश्वा नाश्वैरयुध्यन्त गजा न गजयोधिभिः। उन्मत्तवन्महाराज युध्यन्ते तत्र भारत॥ महान् व्यतिकरो रौद्रः सेनयोः समपद्यता नरनागगणेष्वेव विकीर्णेषु च सर्वशः॥
en: Horsemen then fought not with horsemen and elephant-riders fought not with other elephant-riders. But like men seized with fury, O Bharata, they indiscriminately slaughtered men one another, O monarch, in that battle. Fierce and great was the carnage that then spread itself among the ranks of the two armies, as and elephants, by hundreds, were scattered slain in all directions.

sa: अनादित्वादमध्यत्वादनन्तत्वाच्च सोऽव्ययः। अत्येति सर्वदुःखानि दुःखं ह्यन्तवदुच्यते॥
en: For his being without beginning, iniddle, and cnd, he is Unchangeable. He is above all Sorrow, for Sorrow has limits.

sa: अनुमान्यः प्रसाद्यश्च गुरुः क्रद्धो युधिष्ठिर॥ सम्यङ्गमिथ्या प्रवृत्तेऽपि वर्तितव्यं गुराविह।
en: O Yudhishthira, if the preceptor becomes angry, he should always be pacified with due honors. If the preceptor is entirely in the wrong, still one should follow and honour him.

sa: एकस्तु शब्दो विततः श्रुतोऽसमाभिरुदीरितः॥ जितं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन।
en: We only heard a loud sound uttered by the collected denizens. It said,-Victory to you, O you have eyes like lotus petals! Salutation to you, O Creator of the universe.

sa: कर्णिनालीकनाराचानुत्सृजन् भरतर्षभ। स त्वमोघानिषून मुक्त्वा तृष्णायाभिप्रपीडितः॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, oppressed with thirst, he began to hurl barbed darts, javelins, Narachas and numerous infallible arrows.

sa: भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि परेषां रथसत्तमान्। ये चैवातिरथास्तत्र ये चैव रथयूथपाः॥
en: Again do I desire to hear about the best of the car-warriors of the enemy, those who are Atirathas in that side and those that can lead numbers of chariots.

sa: तमुत्सृष्टं जले गर्भं राधाभर्ता महायशाः। पुत्रत्वे कल्पयामास सभार्यः सूतनन्दनः॥
en: The illustrious husband of Radha took up that child thrown into the water. That son of Suta, (the husband of Radha), with his wife brought him up as their son.

sa: नीलो माहिष्मतीवासो नीलवर्मा रथस्तव। रथवंशेन कदनं शत्रूणां वै करिष्यति॥
en: Nil of Mahishmati clad in a blue coat of mail is a Ratha of your army and with the car warriors under him he will work havoc among the enemy.

sa: जातमिष्टमपत्यं मे त्वमद्यानुपमं भुवि। दत्तमिष्टमधीतं च मया पुरुषसत्तम ॥
en: And incomparable on earth, you have been born to me for a son after my heart. I have given whatever had been wanted (by others); I have finished my studies.

sa: शतचन्द्रं च तचर्म गौतमस्तस्य भारत। व्यधमत् सायकैस्तूर्णं तत उचुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥
en: The son of Gautama then quickly cut-off with his arrows the shield of Prishata's son that was adorned with a hundred moons. At this his people made a loud uproar.

sa: दक्षिणा चात्र देया वै निष्कपञ्चसुवर्णकम्। वाचकाय यथाशक्त्या यथोक्तं फलमिच्छता॥
en: One desirous of acquiring the fruits which belong to a recitations of the Bharata should according to one's power, give unto the reciter Dakshina as also as honorarium in gold.

sa: विपरीतमहं मन्ये मन्दभाग्यं सुतं प्रति। यत्रावध्यन्त समरे सात्वतेन महारथाः॥
en: O Suta, I think Destiny is adverse to the interests of my sons, in as much as they are now being slaughtered by that mighty carwarrior of the Satvata race.

sa: जनस्थानस्थिता राजन् राक्षसा बहवो हताः! खरश्च निहतः संख्ये कथंचिदहमागतः॥
en: O king, a great many Rākşasa living in Janasthāna, have been slain, and Khara also had been slain in battle. I alone have with much difficulty managed to come here.

sa: मार्दवं दण्ड आलस्यं प्रमादश्च सुरोत्तम। मायाः सुविहिताः शक्र सादयन्त्यविचक्षणम्॥
en: His own mildness, the hardship of his punishments, his inactivity and carelessness. O king of the gods, and the deceitful means well applied (by his foes), ruin a foolish king.

sa: योऽसत्सेवीवृथाचारो न श्रोता सुहृदां सताम्। परान् वृणीते स्वान् द्वेष्टि तं गौस्त्यजति भारत॥
en: He, who acts according to the advice of dishonest men, who behaves falsely and does not listen to the advice of good friends and prefers others to those who are his own, is cast off by the earth, O Bharata.

sa: ततो वायुः सुखस्पर्शः पुण्यगन्धवहः शुचिः॥ ववौ देवसमीपस्थः शीतलोऽतीव भारत।
en: Then a breeze delicious and fraught with pleasant smell, perfectly pure, and delightfully cool, O Bharata, began to blow on that spot on account of the presence of the celestials.

sa: दुःशासन रथास्तूर्णं युज्यन्तां भीष्मरक्षिणः। द्वाविंशतिमनीकानि सर्वाण्येवाभिचोदय॥
en: "O Dushasana, without delay draw up our chariots for protecting Bhishma. Urge to battle all our two and twenty divisions.

sa: छायेवानुगता राजन् सततं वशवर्तिनी। भविष्यामि नरव्याघ्र नित्यं प्रियहिते रता॥
en: O king, I shall follow you as a shadow. I shall be always obedient to you. O best of kings, I shall ever remain engaged in doing your favourite works,

sa: अभिनीताश्च शिक्षाभिस्तोत्रांकुशसमाहताः। अप्रभिन्नाः प्रभिन्नानां सम्मुखाभिमुखा ययुः॥
en: Disciplined by training and urged on by pikes and hooks, elephants not in rut attacked those that were in rut.

sa: सभायामृषयस्तस्यां पाण्डवैः सह आसते। आसांचक्रुनरेन्द्राश्च नानादेशसमागताः॥
en: On the seats in that assembly-hall sat with the Pandavas the Rishis and the kings that came from various countries.

sa: असतां विपरीता तु लक्ष्यते भरतर्षभ। विपरीता त्वियं वृत्तिरसकृल्लक्ष्यते त्वयि॥
en: And the inclination of bad men seems to lie towards the opposite direction, o best among the Bharatas, this contemplated action of yours seems to lie in this opposite direction.

sa: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्योऽपि न्यवर्तत। ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा त्वरमाणो महारथः॥
en: The enemy (at that time) could not approach him, like mortals fearing to approach the Death standing before thein. Meanwhile the son of Hridika, riding upon another car, advanced there.

sa: आरक्षो मे हतस्तात रामेणाक्लिष्टकारिणा। जनस्थानमवध्यं तत् सर्वं युधि निपातितम्॥
en: My child, the guards (of Janasthāna) have been slain by Rāma of untiring energy; and all What Janasthāna, incapable of being slain, has (by him) been brought down in battle.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे माद्रीपुत्रौ महाबलौ। वाहिनीं धार्तराष्ट्राणां क्षोभयन्तौ गजाविव॥
en: When you will see in the battle the two sons of Madri endued with great strength making a havoc in the army of the sons of Dhritarashtra like two elephants.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरश्चापमादायेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम्॥ व्यधमद् द्विषतः संख्ये खगराडिव पन्नगान्। देहान् सुनिशितैर्भल्लै रिपूणां नाशयन् क्षणात्॥
en: Taking up his bow resplendent like Indra's bow then Yudhishthira began to destroy his foes in that battle like Garuda killing snakes. With the greatest speed he began to cut off the bodies of his enemies with the keen arrows.

sa: ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा। लिङ्गमस्यार्चयन्ति स्म तच्चाप्यूक्समास्थितम्॥
en: The Rishis, the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras, worship the Phallic emblem of this god, that ever remains erect.

sa: उपास्यमानं व्यासेन पाराशर्येण धीमता। नारदेन च राजर्षे देवलेनासितेन य॥ हतशिष्टैर्नृपैश्चान्यैर्नानादेशसमागतः। रक्षिभिश्च महात्मानं रक्ष्यमाणं समन्ततः॥ शयानं वीरशयने ददर्श नृपतिस्ततः। ततो रथादवातीर्य भ्रातृभिः सह धर्मराट्॥ अभवाद्याथ कौन्तेयः पितामहमरिंदम। द्वैपायनादीन् विप्रांश्च तैश्च प्रत्यभिनन्दितः॥
en: He saw his grandfather waited upon with reverence by Parasharas intelligent, son Vyasa, by Narada, O royal sage, by Devala and Asita, and also by the surviving unslain kings assembled from various parts of the country. Indeed, the king saw that his great grandfather, as he lay on his heroic bed, was guarded on all sides by the warriors appointed for that duty. Getting down from his car, king Yudhishthira, with his brothers, saluted his grandfather, that chastiser of all enemies. They also saluted the Rishis with the Island-born Vyasa at their head. They were saluted in return by them.

sa: स निर्ययौ गजपुराद् याजकैः परिवारितः। दृष्ट्वा निवृत्तमादित्यं प्रवृतं चोत्तरायणम्॥
en: Accompanied by a number of priests he then left the city of Hastinapur having seen that the sun ceasing to go southwards, had begun to proceed in his northward course.

sa: मुदीर्णगम्भीरमहारवाणाम्। विभान्ति रूपाणि बलाहकानां रणोत्सुकानामिव वारणानाम्॥
en: The dense clouds, ornamented with pennonlike lightnings and emitting terrible roars, are appearing like so many elephants, mad after fighting.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। निर्वेदान्मङ्किना गीतं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of what Manki had sung, when freed from attachments. Hear it, O Yudhishthira.

sa: अथापरे सहस्राणि ये गताः शशबिन्दवः। इष्टवाश्वमेधैर्बहुभिर्महद्भिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: One thousand others of the name of Shashabindu who have died after performing many great horse sacrifices with large Dakshinas;

sa: माघोऽयं समनुप्राप्तो मासः सौम्यो युधिष्ठिर। त्रिभागशेषः पक्षोऽयं शुक्लो भवितुमर्हति॥
en: O Yuthishthira, the lunar month of Magha has come. This is, again, the lighted fortnight and a fourth part of it ought by this (according to my calculations) be over.

sa: तं राजा क्षीणभूयिष्ठमाकृतीमात्रसूचितम्। अभिजज्ञे महाबुद्धिं महाबुद्धियुधिष्ठिरः॥
en: He was greatly emaciated. He retained only the shape of a human being. Yudhishthira of great intelligence recognised him, however.

sa: तदुनसं पाण्डुरदन्तमव्रणं शुचिस्मितं पद्मपलाशलोचनम्। द्रक्ष्ये तदार्यावदनं कदा न्वहं प्रसन्नताराधिपतुल्यवर्चसम्॥
en: When shall I behold the blameless face of that noble lady, with its protruding nose; having luminous smiles, having eyes resembling lotuspetals; and bright as the complacent lord of stars?

sa: इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च स्वभावश्चेतना मनः। प्राणापानौ च जीवश्च नित्यं देहेषु देहिनाम्॥
en: The senses, the objects of the senses, the attributes of the objects of Nature, understanding, mind, the vital our and individual soul dwell in the bodies of all embodied creatures.

sa: शङ्खस्वनास्तूर्यरथस्वनाश्च सर्वेष्वनीकेषु ससिंहनादाः। ततः सबाणानि महास्वनानि विस्फार्यमाणानि धनूंषि वीरैः॥
en: Then bows of loud twang, drawn by heroic warriors, with arrows fixed on the bow brings and the sounds of conchs rose above the uproar made by drums and cymbals.

sa: दुमाः कण्टकिनश्चैव कुशाः काशाश्च भामिनि। वने व्याकुलशाखाग्रास्तेन दुःखमतो वनम्॥
en: There are trees full of thorns, having their branches moving to and fro, and the kusa and kāsa grasses with thorny blades constantly undulating; so the wood is full misery.

sa: संजय उवाच वाक्शल्यैस्तव पुत्रेण सोऽतिविद्धो महामनाः। दुःखेन महताऽऽविष्टो नोवाचाप्रियमण्वपि॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon the high-souled Bhishma, thus deeply pierced by the dagger-like words of your son and overwhelmed with grief, spoke not even a single disagreeable word to your son.

sa: अहोरात्रं च संतोषः कर्तव्यो नियतात्मना। फलैर्वृक्षावपतितैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम्॥
en: With the (supply of) fruits that have fallen from the trees man of self discipline must content himself morning and evening; so the wood, O Sītă, is full of misery.

sa: पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः। पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयः॥
en: If the slayer of Pāka celebrates a horse sacrifice, he shall again fearlessly be installed as the chief of deities.

sa: पृथक् च विनिविष्टानां धर्मं धीरोऽनुरुध्यते। मध्यमोऽर्थं कलिं बालः काममेवानुरुध्यते॥
en: If these three are to be pursued separately a wise inan chooses virtue; an indifferent man (i.e. neither wise nor a fool) chooses worldly good, while a boy chooses desire.

sa: तस्य हर्म्यस्य मध्यस्थवेश्म चान्यत् सुनिर्मितम्। बहुनिफूहसंयुक्तं ददर्श पवनात्मजः॥ ब्रह्मणोऽर्थे कृतं दिव्यं दिवि यद् विश्वकर्मणा। विमानं पुष्पकं नाम सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्॥
en: In the midst of that mansion the Wind-god's offspring found another.* excellently constructed, having innumerable mad elephants; that noble car embellished with all gems, entitled Pushpaka, which had been constructed in heaven by Viśvakarmă for Brahmā himself. *The car Puspaka, according to Tirtha, whose view is accepted by Rāmānuja. According to Kataka, Vesma means a bedchamber of husband and wife.

sa: पितरं नूनमाजिस्थं युद्ध्यमानं परैः सह। नाजहात् पितरं वीरमद्यापि मधुसूदन॥
en: He never deserted his father while the latter fought with his enemies. Mark, O destroyer of Madhu, he does not, even in death, leave the side of that heroic father.

sa: शूलपाणिं विरूपाक्षं कुम्भकर्म महाबलम्। हन्तुं न शेकुस्त्रिदशा: कालोऽयमिति मोहिताः॥
en: The immortals themselves thinking the darthanded and fierce-eyed Kumbhakarņa possessed of great strength, as the Destroyer himself, were overwhelmed with stupor and were foiled in their exertions to slay him.

sa: एकमेकेन बाणेन त्रिभिस्त्रीन्दशभिर्दश। लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: And displaying his light-handedness, he with one arrow, severed Laksmana's one, with three his three and with ten his ten.

sa: नान्यो विक्रमपर्याप्तस्त्वमेषां परमः सखा। त्वत्पराक्रमकालोऽयं नान्यं पश्यामि कंचन ॥
en: There is none else. Endowed with profuse prowess, you are the greatest friend of these. This is the hour when you should display you might. Any other see I not.

sa: देवारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरं परमासनम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: They all having got up, the excellent car, of Kuvera at the command of Raghava, rose up in the welkin.

sa: प्रक्षिप्यमाणैरचलैः सहसा जलमुद्धृतम्। समुत्ससर्प चाकाशमवासर्पत्ततः पुनः॥
en: And on rocks being plunged into the waters, the latter, suddenly swelling up, mounted to the welkin, and again subsided.

sa: भरताश्रममासाद्य ससैन्यो राघवस्तदा। अवतीर्य विमानाग्रादवतस्थे महीतले॥
en: That time reaching Bharata's palace Räghava from the top of the aerial car with his army descended upon the earth.

sa: ध्यात्वा पुनरुवाचेदं वचनं रघुसत्तमः। हरीणामीश्वरस्यापि सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः॥
en: Then reflecting for a while, the best of the Raghus again spoke in the presence of Sugrīva, lord of monkeys.

sa: तस्य बाणैः सुविध्वस्तं कवचं काञ्चनं महत्। व्यशीर्यत रथोपस्थे ताराजालमिवाम्बरात्॥
en: And at his arrows (hitting), (Indrajit's) mighty golden mail fell off his person, and dropped to the platform of his car like a cluster of stars dropping from the welkin.

sa: ततो मध्यात्समुद्रस्य सागरः स्वयमुत्थितः। उदयाद्रिमहाशैलान्मेरोरिव दिवाकरः॥
en: Then from forth the mid-sea arose Ocean himself, even as the maker of day rise from the mighty ascending-hill, Meru.

sa: सुग्रीवश्च महाभागः स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्। धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमुवाच ह॥
en: O great hero, Sugrīva has asked of your welfare and has desired me to communicate to you these well meaning words, conducing to the acquirement of piety, wealth and desires.

sa: ततः स हरिशार्दूलस्तामुवाच निशाचरीम्। दृष्ट्वा पुरीमिमां भद्रे पुनर्यास्ये यथागतम्॥
en: Thereat that tiger of a monkey said to that female ranger of the night. After seeing this city, O gentle one, I shall go away even a I have come.

sa: अङ्गदान्यङ्गुलीवेष्टन्वराण्याभरणानि च। हारं च शशिसंकाशमाबबन्ध महात्मनः॥
en: Rāvaņa also decked that high-souled one with Angadas, and finger fences and noble ornaments, and a chain resembling the Moon.

sa: प्राकारान्तरवीथ्यश्च वेदिकाश्चैत्यसंश्रयाः। श्वभ्राश्च पुष्करिण्यश्च सर्वं तेनावलोकितम्॥
en: And he saw the abodes of the nobility, the daises, the trees by the crossings, the holes, and the tanks.

sa: ततस्तैः स्वगणैरिष्टैरिन्द्रजित् प्रतिपूजितः। युद्धोद्धतकृतोत्साहः संग्राम सम्प्रपद्यत॥
en: Excited with desire for fight and worked up with energy, Indrajit, eulogised by the friendly Rākşasas, set out for battle.

sa: स क्रोधवशमापन्नो हयानामपसर्पणे॥ मुमोच निशितान्बाणाराघवाय दशाननः।
en: And finding his steeds thus removed he was exercised with wrath. And the Ten-necked one discharged sharpened arrows at Raghava.

sa: सीते राक्षसराजेन परिक्रीड यथासुखम्। जानीमहे यथा भीरु स्त्रीणां यौवनमध्रुवम्॥
en: Do you sport, O Sītā, at your pleasure, with the lord of the Rākşasas. We know, for certain, O timid damsel, that the youth of the females, is very transient.

sa: प्रदग्धकायानपरान्राक्षसान्निर्गतान्बहिः। सहसा ह्युत्पतन्ति स्म हरयोऽथ युयुत्सवः॥
en: As Rākşasas having their bodies burnt came out of houses, monkeys eager for encounter on a sudden sprung upon them.

sa: ताडितः स तया तत्र गदया भीमवेगया। स कपिर्मारुतबलस्तं प्रहारमचिन्तयन्॥ धूम्राक्षस्य शिरोमध्ये गिरिशृङ्गमपातयत्।
en: Thus assailed with the mace of fearful impetuosity, the monkey endowed with he mace of fearful impetuosity, the monkey endowed with the strength of the wind without at all heeding that blow, let fall a mountain-top right against Dhumraksa's head.

sa: चक्रप्रहारैर्विनिकृत्तशीर्षाः संचूर्णिताङ्गाश्च गदाप्रहारैः। असिप्रहारैर्द्विविधा विभिन्नाः पतन्ति शैला इव राक्षसेन्द्राः॥
en: Their heads cut by discus, their parts of bodies crushed with the mace, and hewn in twain with swords, thus they foremost of Rākşasas fell like to hills (toppling headlong).

sa: अस्या हि पुष्पावनतानशाखाः शोकं दृढं वै जनयन्त्यशोकाः। रभ्युत्थितो नैकसहस्ररश्मिः॥
en: The branches of the Asoka trees, lowered down with flowers are as if enhancing her grief as also the Moon of many thousand rays, at the expire of the winter."

sa: चैत्यं निकुम्भिलामद्य प्राप्य होमं करिष्यति। हुतवानुपयातो हि देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: Today, going to the sacrificial ground (called) Nikumbhilā, he will offer oblations into fire; and there the deity of fire will present himself along with Vasava and the (other) divinities.

sa: नीलनागाभया वेण्या जघनं गतयैकया। नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥
en: Her braid of long hair resembling a black serpent falling on her back it appeared as if the Earth was filled with dark-blue forests on the disappearance of the rains.

sa: तत्सुभीमं महाद्धं हरिराक्षससंकुलम्। प्रबभौ शस्त्रबहुलं शिलापादपसंकुलम्॥
en: That mighty and dreadful encounter of the Räksasas and the monkeys, was waged with countless weapons and rocks and trees.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः। बभूव संरब्धतरो युगान्त इव पावकः॥
en: But reflecting only for a while, he with his eyes surcharged with tears was filled with greater martial ardour, and resembled the fire risen at the universal dissolution. Then thinking.

sa: क्षत्रियाश्च महात्मानो नानाजनपदेश्वराः। रामस्योपविशन्पायुं शक्रस्येव यथामराः॥
en: And there sat around Rāma the Kasatriya kings hailing from various provinces as the celestials sit encircling their lord Indra.

sa: यत्तदाभिप्रसन्नेन सशरं कार्मुकं महत्। देवासुरविमर्देषु मम दत्तं स्वयंभुवा॥ अद्य तूर्यशतैर्भीमं धनुरुत्थाप्यतां मम। रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव वधाय परमाहवे॥
en: Do you, beating hundreds of drums, today raise that mighty and dreadful bow of mine which, with arrows, had been bestowed on one by the gratified Self-sprung at the war of the gods and Asuras, so that I may therewith compass the destruction of Rama and Lakşmaņa in mighty battle.

sa: संरक्तनयनः क्रोधाच्चलन्मौलिनिशाचरः। पद्मनाभमिदं प्राह वचनं पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: And with his eyes reddened, that night-ranger waxing wroth, shaking his head, addressed that prime of male persons Padmanabha, saying.

sa: नागगन्धर्वकन्याश्च महर्षितनयाश्च याः। दैत्यदानवकन्याश्च विमाने शतशोरुदन्॥
en: And wept there in the chariot, hundreds of the females of Nagas, Gandharvas, of great ascetics, Daityas and of Dänavas.

sa: वधे तस्य समाज्ञप्ते रावणेन दुरात्मना। निवेदितवतो दौत्यं नानुमेने विभीषणः॥
en: On the death of that one who had proclaimed his own position of being an envoy, having been ordered by the wicked-minded Ravana, Vibhisana did not agree (with the decision).

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा बहुदुर्जयाः। राक्षसाः किंकरा नाम रावणस्य मनोऽनुगाः॥
en: Hearing this the lord of the Rākşasas despatched a chosen band of demons named Kinkaras. (Literally it means servants—hero it means his own personal attendants who were brave and heroic.)

sa: एष चूडामणिर्दिव्यो मया सुपरिरक्षितः। एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्यामि व्यसने त्वामिवानघ॥
en: This jewel for the head I had preserved with care. In my misfortune, O sinless one, I used to inspire cheerfulness by a sight a sight of this, resembling yourself.

sa: तस्मात् प्रसीद शत्रुघ्न राक्षसेन्द्र दुरासद। युक्तायुक्तं विनिश्चित्य दूतदण्डो विधीयताम्॥
en: Therefore, O destroyer of enemies, be pacified. O lord of Raksasas, difficult to approach, consider what is proper or otherwise, and then do you mete out punishment to the envoy.

sa: अतिमात्रं शरौघेण दीप्यमानौ नरोत्तमौ। तानिषून्पततो भल्लैरनेकैविचकर्ततुः॥
en: Those two best of men, hurt with his arrows, became more effulgent and beffled the shafts discharged by the Räkşasa.

sa: अदिताश्चैव बाणौषैस्ते प्रवेकेण रक्षसाम्। सौमित्रेः सा विनिर्भिद्य प्रविष्टा धरणीतलम्॥
en: And further, they were (all the white) sore assailed with showers of shafts by the foremost Rākṣasa of them all. The dart having pierced Sumitra's son, had entered the earth.

sa: इमं श्रुत्वा तु विक्रान्तस्त्वरमाणोऽहमागतः। सहसैवावयोः स्नेहात्सखित्वमनुपालयन्॥ मोक्षितौ च महाघोरादस्मात्सायकबन्धनात्।
en: Hearing this, I, summoning energy: have come hither swiftly, and I, doing by you as a friend, have from affection at once set you free from these dreadful arrowy bonds.

sa: हतैर्गजपदात्यश्वैस्तद्वभूव रणाजिरम्। आक्रीडभूमिः क्रुद्धस्य रुद्रस्येव महात्मनः॥
en: The battle field, filled with slain horses, elephants and infantry, looked like the high-souled and enraged Rudra's arena of sports.

sa: ततस्ताल्लक्ष्य वित्रस्तान्यक्षेन्द्रांश्च सहस्रशः। धनाध्यक्षो महायक्षं माणिचारमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing the foremost of the Yakşas by thousands undergoing trepidation, the lord of riches spoke to a mighty Yakşa Māņichara.

sa: राक्षसेनाहते तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः। स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजोऽभ्यवर्धत॥
en: Although struck and resisted by the Rākşasa with arrows, the energy of that one, endowed by nature with prowess-increased greatly.

sa: सोऽश्वकर्ण समासाद्य रोषदान्वितो हरिः। तूर्णमुत्पाटयामास महागिरिमिवोच्छ्रितम्॥
en: That monkey, wrought up with rage and pride, grasping an Aśvakarņa elevated like to a hill, at once uprooted it.

sa: तेन सुत्रीववाक्येन सावमानेन मानितः। अग्नेराज्यहुतस्येव तेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत॥
en: Being thus honoured (by Sugrīva) with fair speech, (Kumbha) flamed up like a flame into which oblations have been poured.

sa: हतप्रवीरा रामेण निराशा जीविते वयम्। अपश्यन्त्यो भयस्यान्तमनाथा विलपामहे ॥
en: By Rāma all the heroes have been slaindespair has taken possession of our minds-we do not behold the end of our terror and are bewailing being deprived of our lords.

sa: अभिनन्दाम ते सर्वे संश्रुत्येन्द्रजितो वधम्। अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां महामायाधरो युधि॥
en: Hearing of the destruction of Indrajit, we congratulate you (on your success). He was in capable of being slain by all creatures, and in battle possessed mighty powers of illusion.

sa: तस्यादूरात्स पद्मिन्यो नानाद्विजगणायुताः। ददर्श कपिशार्दूलो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः॥
en: That foremost of monkeys, Hanumăn, the son of Maruti, beheld, at some distance, ponds filled with lotuses and various birds.

sa: सुग्रीवो हनुमांश्चैव महेन्द्रसदृशद्युती। स्नातौ दिव्यनिभैर्वस्त्रैर्जग्मतुः शुभकुण्डलौ॥
en: Sugrīva and Hanuman, graceful like Mahendra, bathed, dressed in celestial clothes and wearing excellent kundalas, proceeded (to view the city).

sa: तस्मात्त्वया समारब्धं कर्म ह्यप्रतिमं परैः। अहं समीकरिष्यामि हत्वा शस्तवानघ॥
en: But as you have entered upon a course of action which is improper even in respect of foes, I will, O sinless one, perform your work by slaying your enemies.

sa: तथैव सकलैर्वृक्षैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च वानराः। अभिजघ्नुनिजघ्नुश्च समरे सर्वराक्षसान्॥
en: In the same way the monkeys in the conflict fell to slaying and wounding the Rākşasas with trees and hill-tops.

sa: निघ्नन्तमृक्षाधिपतिं राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः। परिभर्त्य भयं त्यक्त्वा तमनेकविधायुधाः॥ शरैः परशुभिस्तीक्ष्णैः पट्टिशैर्यष्टितोमरैः। जाम्बवन्तं मृधे जघ्नुनिघ्नन्तं राक्षसी चमूम्॥
en: Thereat Räkşasas, endowed with exceeding strength, equipped with various weapons reproaching the lord of bears, as he was engaged in smiting (the foe), and renouncing fear, with shafts and sharp axes and pațțiśas and yaşțis, and tomaras, in the encounter assailed Jambavān, who was engaged in beating the Räkşasa forces.

sa: दैवतैस्तु समागम्य सर्वेश्चन्द्रपुरोगमैः। वृषध्वजस्त्रिपुरहा महादेवः प्रतोषितः॥
en: Thereupon the celestials headed by Indra engaged in propitiating Mahādeva, the slayer of Tripura, and who rides upon a bull.

sa: अमोघो ोष सर्वेषां प्राणिनाममितप्रभः। कालदण्डो मया सृष्टः सर्वं मृत्युपुरस्कृतः।॥
en: This rod of Kāla, of immeasurable might and incapable of being resisted by creatures, was created by me as having the power of compassing th : death of all beings.

sa: तन्नो देव भयार्तानामभयं दातुमर्हसि। अशिवं वपुरास्थाय जहि वै देवकण्टकान्॥
en: Therefore, O god, it behove you to liberate us from fear, who have been greatly tormented by it. Do you, assuming your terrific form, slay the thorns of the celestials.

sa: ततो युद्धाय तेजस्वी रक्षोगणबलैर्वृतः। निर्ययावुद्यतधनुः कालान्तकयमोपमः॥
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent (Ravana) resembling Death, with uplifted bow, sallied out for battle along with the army of Rākşasa.

sa: वीज्यमानस्ततो वीरो हैमैर्हेमविभूषणः। चारुचामरमुख्यैश्च मुख्यः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: That hero garnished in golden ornaments that foremost of all bowmen, was fanned by an excellent and graceful golden chowri.

sa: नूनमन्यां मया जाति' वारितं दानमुत्तमम्। याहमद्यैव शोचामि भार्या सर्वातिथेरिह॥
en: Without doubt, in another birth I had abstained from choice gifts, and therefore it is that I sorrow today, albeit being the wife of one that (ever dear) to guests.

sa: तं प्रस्थितं महात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः। संहर्षमाणा बहवो धनुःप्रवरपाणयः॥
en: As that high-souled (hero) marched, he was followed by countless mighty (Rākşasas) breathing spirits; bearing bows in their strong hands.

sa: अपक्रान्तेष्वमात्येषु प्रहस्ते च निपातिते। रावणोऽभ्यद्रवत्तूर्णमर्जुनं नृपसत्तमम्॥
en: All the councillors having thus fled away and Prahasta being slain, Rāvaņa speedily proceeded towards Arjuna, the foremost of kings.

sa: तयोः समागमे तस्मिन् प्रीतिरुत्पादिताद्भुता। परस्परेण चालापं विश्वस्तौ तौ प्रचक्रतुः॥
en: Sītā, at that time, attained such a wonderful joy, as would have been acquired by her in the company (of Rama and Laksmana). And they confidingly conversed with each other.

sa: त्यजाशु कोपं सुखधर्मनाशनं भजस्व धर्म रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम्। प्रसीद जीवेम सपुत्रबान्धवाः प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली॥
en: Forsake your wrath at once, which destroy happiness and virtue; and follow righteousness, which enhance enjoyment and fame. Be you propitious, so that we may live (at ease) along with our sons and relatives. Render (back) Maithili to Dasaratha's son.

sa: तयोर्वेगवतोर्वेगं निहत्य स महाबलः। निपपात पुनर्भूमौ सुपर्ण इव वेगितः॥
en: Thereat resisting the furious rush of those gifted with ebullient erergy, that exceedingly powerful one descended to the earth with the violence of the Fair-feathered (bird).* (Suparna-a name of Garuda.)

sa: इत्युक्त्वा पञ्च नाराचानाकर्णापूरिताशरान्। विजषान महावेगाल्लक्ष्मणो राक्षसोरसि॥
en: Saying this, Lakşmaņa drawing his bow to its full bent, hit at the Raksasas chest five nārācas, wondrous impetuous arrows.

sa: बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रश्च अवध्वकवचो युधि। धनुरादाय यस्तिष्ठन्नदृश्यो भवतीन्द्रजित्॥
en: (His son) Indrajit, equipped with invincible armour, bow and finger-protector made of the skin of iguana, becomes invisible in fight.

sa: प्राञ्जलिर्भरतो भूत्वा प्रहृष्टो राघवोन्मुखः। यथार्थेनार्घ्यपाद्याद्यैस्ततो राममपूजयत्॥
en: Facing Rāghava and with folded hands Bharata delightedly worshipped him with agreeable words, Arghya and water to wash his feet.

sa: हनूमन्तं जिघांसन्तं समुद्यतशरासनम्। रावणात्मजमाचष्टे लक्ष्मणाय विभीषणः॥
en: Then Vibhīşana pointed out to Lakşmaņa the son of Ravana, who with his bow upraised, was eager to slay Hanumān.

sa: क्षत्रियैर्बहुभिवीरैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः। आसीद्वसुमती पूर्णा महद्भिरिव पादपैः॥
en: The Earth was filled with various heroic Kșatriyas, resembling Sakra in prowess as she is adorned now with various trees.

sa: चम्पकाशोकबकुलशालतालसमाकुला। तमालापनसच्छन्ना नागमालासमावृता॥ हिन्तालैरर्जुनैींपैः सप्तवर्णैः सुपुष्पितैः। तिलकैः कर्णिकारैश्च पाटलैश्च समन्ततः॥ शुशुभे पुष्पिताणैव लतापरिगतदुमैः। लङ्कां बहुविधैर्दृश्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती॥
en: Abounding in champakas, asokas, vakulas, śālas, and palms; covered with tamālas and panišas, and environed all around with trees, and surrounded with Hintālas, Arjunas, blossoming Saptaparmas, Tilakas, Karmikāras, and Patalas, trees with flowering tops, entertwined with creepers, Larkā looked exceedingly lovely, with various sights, resembling the Amarāvatī herself of Indra.

sa: गृहीतां लाडितां स्तम्भे यूथपेन विनाकृताम्। निःश्वसन्ती सुदुःखात गजराजवधूमिव ॥
en: And she like the daughter-in-law of the lord of elephants, caught, separated from her band and tied to a pillar, was overwhelmed with grief and was sighing again and again.

sa: एवं न दग्धः स मया भवता च न संशयः। अन्येनाप्यषिमुख्येन न दग्धो न च पातितः॥
en: The selfborn Brahman granted him this boon, and it is therefore that neither yourself nor I have been able to consume him. Forsooth, it is for this reason that none one else amongst the foremost of Rishis has been able to consume or throw him down from his elevated position.

sa: इत्युक्तस्तामुत्तङ्कस्तु भर्तुर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। श्रुत्वा च सा तदा प्रादात् ततस्ते मणिकुण्डले॥
en: Thus addressed by the king, Utanka returned to the queen and reported to her the world of her husband. Hearing those words, the queen gave to Utanka her jewelled ear-rings.

sa: ततः संवर्तश्चैत्यगतो महात्मा यथा वह्निः प्रज्वलितो द्वितीयः। हवींष्युच्चैराह्वयन् देवसंघान् जुहावाग्नौ मन्त्रवत् सुप्रतीतः॥
en: And then the great Samvarta ascending the altar, and loO king radiant as the second embodiment of the Burning Fire, loudly addressing the celestials with satisfaction, offered oblations of clarified butter to the fire with incantation of the sacred hymns.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु महात्मानो लघुभूयिष्ठसैनिकाः। पुनर्जग्मुर्महात्मानं सदारास्तं महीपतिम्॥
en: The great Pandavas accompanied by their wives, and with a small retinue, went to the hermitage of the great monarch.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः पार्थन स राजा बभ्रुवाहनः। उवाच पितरं धीमानिदमस्राविलेक्षणः॥ उपयास्यामि धर्मज्ञ भवतः शासनादहम्। अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे द्विजातिपरिवेषकः॥
en: Thus addressed by Partha, king Babhruvahana of great intelligence, with tearful eyes, said these words to his father, 'O you who are conversant with every duty, I shall certainly go, at your command, to the great Horse-Sacrifice, and take upon myself the task of distributing food among the twice-born ones!

sa: यावदक्षिनिमेषाणि ज्वलन्ते तावती: समाः। रूपवान् बलवांश्चापि नरो भवति दीपदः॥
en: The giver of lights becomes gifted with beauty of form and strength for years corresponding with the number of twinkles for which the lights given by him burn or blaze.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच यथोदाहृतमेतत् ते मयि नाम महायुते। दुर्धार्यमेतन्मनसा गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said O you of great effulgence, the etymological signification you have given of your name is what I cannot comprehend. Go and plunge into this lake filled with lotuses.

sa: तां त्वकामयत श्रीमान् वरुणः पूर्वमेव ह। स चागम्य वनप्रस्थं यमुनायां जहार ताम्॥
en: It so took place, however, that the beautiful Varuna had, from a long time before, coveted the girl. Coming to the forest where Utathya lived, Varuna stole away the girl when she had plunged into the Yamuna for a bath.

sa: अग्निरुवाच ततो देवैः सहितो देवराजो रथे युक्त्वा तान् हरीन् वाजिमुख्यान्। राविक्षितस्याप्रमेयस्य सोमम्॥
en: Then the King of the Celestials attended by the other deities and riding in his chariot drawn by the most excellent horses, approached the sacrificial altar of that son of Avikshit and drank the Soma libations of that peerless king.

sa: मतङ्ग परमं स्थानं वार्यमाणोऽसकृन्मया। चिकीर्षस्येव तपसा सर्वथा न भविष्यसि॥
en: I am repeatedly forbidding you. By trying, however, to attain that high dignity by the help of your penances, despite my repeated admonitions, you are sure to meet with destruction.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। बृहस्पतेश्च संवादमिन्द्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: About it is cited the old discourse between the celestial preceptor Brihaspati and Indra the kung of Heaven, O Yudhishthira.

sa: गवां देवोपरिष्टाद्धि समाख्यातं शतक्रतो। एता हि वरदत्ताश्च वरदाश्चापि वासव॥
en: Kine got many excellent forms, O Vasava, and are themselves givers of boons. They are called Surabhis. Of sacred deeds and gifted with many auspicious marks they are highly purifying.

sa: आदधत् सर्वभूतेषु विश्रम्भं परमं शुभम्। जलेचरेषु सर्वेषु शीतरश्मिरिव प्रभुः॥
en: The Rishi inspired all creatures with trust. And he inspired similar confidence in all creatures living in water. The powerful ascetic resembled the Moon himself in his conduct to all.

sa: मक्रोधनोऽकरवं त्रिंशतोऽब्दान्। शतं गवामष्टशतानि चैव दिने दिने ह्यददं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः॥
en: For thirty years, with heart perfectly freed from anger, I observed the Turayana vow that has very superior merit, and gave away to the Brahmanas every day nine hundred kine.

sa: स तमभ्यर्च्य राजानं नाम संश्राव्य चात्मनः। निषीदेत्यभ्यनुज्ञातो बृस्यामुपविवेश ह॥
en: He saluted the old king giving his name. 'Sit down', were the words the old king said. With Dhritarashtra's permission, Yudhishthira sat himself down on a mat of Kusha grass.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच भीम ज्येष्ठो गुरुर्मे त्वं नातोऽन्यद् वक्तुमुत्सहे। धृतराष्ट्रस्तु राजर्षिः सर्वथा मानमर्हति॥
en: Arjuna said O Bhima, you are my elder brother and, therefore, my senior and preceptor. I dare not say anything more than what I have already said. The royal sage Dhritarashtra deserves to be honoured by us in every way.

sa: ऊष्मा प्रकुपितः काये तीव्रवायुसमीरितः। शरीरमनुपर्येत्य सर्वान् प्राणान् रुणद्धि वै॥
en: Urged on by the Wind which becomes violent, the heat in the body, becoming excited, and reaching every part of the body one after another, restrains all the vital airs.

sa: बाला क्षुधार्ता नारी च रक्ष्या त्वं सततं मया। उपवासपरिश्रान्ता त्वं हि बान्धवनन्दिनी॥
en: You are a child, afflicted by hunger, and belong to the softer sex. You should be always protected by mc! Alas, I have to see you worn out with fasts, O you who are the delighter of all your kinsmen.

sa: तथा महात्मनस्तस्य तपस्युग्रे च वर्ततः। अनाथस्येव निधनं तिष्ठत्स्वास्मासु बन्धुषु॥ दुर्विज्ञेया गतिर्ब्रह्मन् पुरुषाणां मतिर्मम। यत्र वैचित्रवीर्योऽसौ दग्ध एवं वनाग्निना॥
en: When such a fate overtook that great king who was engaged in austere penances, despite the fact of his having such kinsmen as ourselves all alive. It seems to me, O twice born one, that the end of human beings is difficult to guess. Alas, who would have thought that the son of Vichitravirya would thus be burns to death.

sa: इदं शृणु महाप्राज्ञ धर्मपुत्र महायशः। इतिहासं पुरावृत्तं शरणार्थे महाफलम्॥
en: Bhisham said: O Dharma's son of great wisdom and widespread fame, listen to this old, history regarding the great merit of granting protection to others when protection is humbly sought.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच घृतक्षीरप्रदा गावो घृतयोन्यो घृतोद्भवाः। घृतनद्यो घृतावर्तास्ता मे सन्तु सदा गृहे।॥
en: Vasishtha said Kine give clarified butter and milk. They are the sources of clarified butter and they have originated from clarified butter. They are rivers of clarified butter, and eddies of clarified butter. Let kine ever be in my house.

sa: मारीचमादितः कृत्वा सर्वे चैवाथ भार्गवाः। अपत्यानीति सम्प्रेक्ष्य क्षमयाम पितामह॥
en: Marichi is your first offspring. All these also that are called Bhargavas are your progeny. LoO king at this fact, O Grandfather, we shall all help and support one another.

sa: यज्वानश्च तथैवान्ये निर्होमाच तथाऽपरे। केन कर्मविपाकेन भवन्तीह वदस्व मे॥
en: Some there are who are given to the performance of sacrifices and some who do not care for Homa. For what deeds to men become possessed of these different natures.

sa: अपां फेनसवर्णां तु सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां वारुणं लोकमाप्नुते॥
en: By giving away a frothycoloured cow, with a calf and vessel of white brass for milking her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires the region of Varuna.

sa: येषां दाराः प्रतीक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षकाः। अन्नानि प्रातःसवने नियता ब्रह्मचारिणः॥
en: Brahmacharins of controlled senses, O son, by eating at one's house in the forenoon, cause the three sacrificial fires to be pleased with the householder at whose house they eat.

sa: तथा स पित्राभिहतो वाग्वज्रेण कृताञ्जलिः। प्रसीदेति ब्रुवन्नेव गतसत्त्वोऽपतद् भुवि॥
en: Thus struck by his father with the thunder of his speech, the son, with joined hands, said, “Be pleased with me. Soon, however, he dropped down on the earth dead.

sa: येषां त्रिवर्गः कृत्येषु वर्तते नोपहीयते। शिष्टाचारप्रवृत्ताश्च तान् नमस्याम्यहं सदा॥
en: I always bow to those persons, who while doing all their works have an eye on the threefold objects of life, and who are observant of truth and righteous behaviour.

sa: समेन सर्वभूतेषु निःस्पृहेण निराशिषा। शक्या गतिरियं गन्तुं सर्वत्र समदर्शिना॥
en: This end is capable of being attained by one who is alike to all creatures, who is without attachment, who is without expectations, and who looks equally on all things.

sa: साधु साध्विति चोद्दिष्टं दैवतैः पितृभिस्तथा। भूतैश्चैव सुसंहष्टैः पूजिता साप्यरुन्धती॥
en: After Arundhati had said these words all the deities and ancestors applauded her saying, Excellent, Excellent, Indeed all the beings there were highly pleased and all of them adored Arundhati.

sa: स चापि राजवचनादाचार्यो गौतमः कृपः। सेनामादाय सेनानी प्रययावाश्रमं प्रति॥
en: The preceptor Kripa also, of Gautama's race, that great leader of army, taking all the forces with him, proceeded, at the command of the king, towards the old king's hermitage.

sa: ततो द्विजैः परिवृतः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। संस्तूयमानो बहुभिः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः॥ पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। रथानीकेन महता निर्जगाम कुरुद्वहः॥
en: The Kuru king Yudhishthira, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, surrounded on a large number of Brahmanas' his praises lauded by a large band of Sutas and Magadhas and bards, and with a white umbrella held over his head, and surrounded by a large number of cars, started on his journey.

sa: दुर्योधनप्रभृतयो दृष्टा लोकान्तरं गताः। व्यासस्य तपसो वीर्याद् भवतश्च समागमात्॥
en: We have seen Duryodhana and others who have become dwellers of the other world, through the power of Vyasa's penances and through the merit of this my meeting with you.

sa: सोऽहं द्विजेभ्यः प्रणतो विप्राद् दोषमवाप्तवान्। गतिमन्यां न पश्यामि मदयन्तीसहायवान्॥
en: As for myself, I am always bent in humility before them. I am overtaken by a calamity through a Brahmana. Possessed of Madayanti, I do not see any other refuge.

sa: तत: क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद् भूमिमुतथ्यो ब्राह्मणोत्तमः। दर्शयस्व स्थलं भद्रे षट् सहस्रशतह्रदम्॥
en: Then Utathya, that foremost of twiceborn persons, filled with anger, commanded Earth, saying, O amiable one, do you show land where there are at present the six hundred thousand lakes.

sa: प्रययुस्तांस्तदा राजन्नुग्रसेनो न्यवारयत्। ततः पुराद् विनिष्क्रम्य वृष्ण्यन्धकपतिस्तदा॥ सहितो वसुदेवेन मातुलेन किरीटिनः। तौ समेत्य कुरुश्रेष्ठ विधिवत्प्रीतिपूर्वकम्॥
en: King Ugrasena, however, soon went out and forbade those youths from doing what they thought. Then the king of the Vrislinis and the Andhakas, issuing out of his palace, with Vasudeva, the maternal uncle of Arjuna, in his company, cheerfully met the Kuru hero and received him with due rites.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। संवादं वासुदेवस्य पृथिव्याश्च भरतर्षभ॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old history of the conversation between Vasudeva and the Earth, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: दत्तात्रेयप्रसादाच्च मया प्राप्तमिदं बलम्। लोके च परमा कीर्तिर्धर्मश्चाचरितो महान्॥
en: Through the favour of Dattatreya I have acquired this might of mine. Through his favour I have been able to perform great feats in the world and acquire high inerit.

sa: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा स्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत्। एष मे पार्श्वतो वह्निर्युष्पच्छ्रेयोऽभिधास्यति॥
en: Hearing these words of theirs, the SelfCreate said to them in reply, Here, the god of fire is sitting beside me. Even he will do what is for your good.

sa: पुष्पिताः फलवन्तश्च तर्पयन्तीह मानवान्। वृक्षदं पुत्रवद् वृक्षास्तारयन्ति परत्र तु॥
en: Trees that bear flowers and fruits please all men. The planter of trees is saved in the next world by the trees he plants like children saving their own father.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच धर्मागतेन त्यागेन भगवन् स्वर्गमस्ति चेत्। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि भाषितुम्॥
en: Janamejaya said If, O illustrious one, celestial region is the fruit of riches acquired by fair means, do you fully describe it to me. You are wellconversant with the subject and, it is, therefore, proper for you to explain it.

sa: अलंचक्रुश्च माल्यौघैः पुरुषा नागसाह्वयम्। पताकाभिर्विचित्रार्ध्वजैश्च विविधैरपि॥
en: The citizens docked the city of Hastinapur with many garlands of flowers with beautiful pennons and standards of various kinds.

sa: प्रत्याख्यातश्च तेनाहं जीवितुं नाद्य कामये। परित्यक्तश्च गुरुणा दूषितश्चास्मि नारद॥
en: Having met with this refusal from him, I have no desire to live any longer now, for by his abandoning me thus, I have, O Narada, become sullied with sin.

sa: ततस्तत्र समाजग्मुस्तापसा नियतव्रताः। पाण्डवानागतान् द्रष्टुं कौतूहलसमन्विताः॥
en: Many ascetics of rigid vows, filled with curiosity, came there for seeing the Pandavas who had arrived at the hermitage.

sa: जिह्वामूले स्थितास्तस्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः। तिमेरास्यमनुप्राप्ता यथा मत्स्या महार्णवे॥
en: Indeed, all the gods with Vasava seemed to stand at the root of that great Asura's tongue, as fishes when they enter into the wide open mouth of a leviathan.

sa: सुहृदां दुःखमार्तानां न प्रमोक्ष्यसि हानिजम्। अलमर्थगुणैर्हीनं तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Seeing virtuous persons living like householders, unrighteous persons living according to the forest mode, and liberated persons attached to domesticity and fixed abodes, you have become so pale and lean.

sa: एतच्चैनं योऽनुतिष्ठेत युक्तः सत्ये रतो गुरुशुश्रूषया च। दक्षः क्षान्तो देवतार्थी प्रशान्तः शुचिर्बुद्धो धर्मशीलोऽनहंवाद॥ महत् फलं प्राप्यते स द्विजाय दत्त्वा दोग्ध्रीं विधिनानेन धेनुम्। नित्यं दद्यादेकभक्तः सदा च सत्ये स्थितो गुरुशुश्रूषिता च॥
en: Given to penances and truth, always in Scriptures through duliful services done to his preceptor, gifted with forgiving nature, engaged in the adoration of the deities, possessed of a tranquil soul, pure, enlightened, observant of all duties, and freed from every sort of egotism, that man who makes a gift of a cow to a Brahmana, forsooth, acquires great merit through that act of his, viz., the gift, according to proper rites, of a cow giving profuse milk. Hence, one, with singleness of devotion, observant of truth, and engaged in humbly serving his preceptor, should always make gifts of kine.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पुनरेव हि मे बुद्धिः संशये परिमुह्यति। अपारे मार्गमाणस्य परं तीरमपश्यतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, my understanding is once more stupefied by doubt. I am on this side of the ocean, engaged in searching after the ineans of crossing it. I do not, however, see the other shore of the ocean.

sa: ब्रह्मणः पदमव्यक्तं मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः। नाहं पुनरिहागन्ता मर्त्यलोकं परंतप॥
en: Indeed, I shall come by the condition, which is unmanifest, of Brahma. Do not doubt this. O scorcher of enemies. I shall not return to this world of mortal creatures.

sa: अस्मिल्लोके सदा ह्येते परत्र च सुखप्रदाः। चरन्ते मान्यमाना वै प्रदास्यन्ति सुखं तव।॥
en: Those persons of whom I speak are always givers of happiness in this world as well as in the next. Respected by all, they move about in this world, and, if adored by you are sure to grant you happiness.

sa: अनुगम्यमाना व्यासेन नारदेनासितेन च॥ कृष्णेन भरतस्त्रीभिर्ये च पौरा: सभागताः।
en: They were followed by Vyasa, Narada, Asita, Krishna, by the ladies of the Bharata family, as also by such of the citizens of Hastinapur as had come to the place.

sa: द्रोणकर्णप्रभृतयो येन प्रतिसमासिताः॥ रणे महेन्द्रप्रतिमाः स कथं नाप्नुयाद् दिवम्।
en: He by whom Drona and Karna and others were checked in battle, heroes who were equal to Indra himself in power, why would not he ascend to the celestial region.

sa: चतुर्थभक्तक्षपणं वैश्ये शूद्रे विधीयते। त्रिरात्रं न तु धर्मज्ञैर्विहितं धर्मदर्शिभिः॥
en: Fasts for two nights have been ordained for Vaishyas and Shudras (on certain special occasions). Fasts for three nights, however, have not been ordained for them by persons knowing duties.

sa: नैशात्मक तमो विद्यात् त्रिगुणं मोडसंज्ञितम्। अधर्मलक्षणं चैव नियतं पापकर्मसु। तामसं रूपमेतत् तु दृश्यते चापि सङ्गत्तम्॥
en: Darkness should be known to have the night for its essence. It has three marks, and is (otherwise) called Delusion. It has sin also for its mark, and it is always present in all sinful deeds. This is the nature of Ignorance and it appears also as confined with others.

sa: ततो दशशते काले लभते शूद्रतामपि। शूद्रयोनावपि ततो बहुशः परिवर्तते॥
en: Passing a period of one thousand years in that order one is next born as a Shudra. In the Shudra order, again, one has to wander for a long time.

sa: धर्मदोषास्त्विमे पञ्च येषां नास्तीह निष्कृतिः। असम्भाष्या अनाचारा वर्जनीया नराधमाः॥
en: These five kinds of men sullied with vicious deeds have no escape. Indeed, these wretched men of sinful conduct, should never be talked to. Indeed they should always be avoided.

sa: सरोभिन्नं तया नद्या सरयूः सा ततोऽभवत्। हताश्च खलिनो यत्र स देशः खलिनोऽभवत्॥
en: The lake was penetrated by that river. And as that celestial river piercing through the waters of the lake, appeared, it flowed on, under the name of Sarayu. The palace whereon those Danavas fell came to be called after them.

sa: इत्युक्तः स मुनी राज्ञा तेन हृष्टेन तद्वचः। च्यवनः प्रत्युवाचेदं हृष्टः परपुरंजयम्॥ सज्जीकुरु रथं क्षिप्रं यस्ते सांग्रामिको मतः। सायुधः सपताकश्च शक्तीकनकयष्टिमान्॥ किङ्किणीस्वननिर्घोषो युक्तस्तोरणकल्पनैः। जाम्बूनदनिबद्धश्च परमेषुशतान्वितः॥
en: Thus addressed by the delighted and contented King, the ascetic said to him-Do you promptly get ready that chariot with which you attack hostile cities! cities! Indeed, that warchariot of yours, with every weapon, with its standard and flags, its darts and javelins and golden columns and poles, should be made ready. Its rattle resembles the tinkling of bells. It is adorned with numberless arches made of pure gold. It is always furnished with hundreds of high and excellent weapons!

sa: हाहाकृतमभूत् सर्वमैरावतनिवेशनम्। वासुकिप्रमुखानां च नागानां जनमेजय॥
en: Cries of woe were heard throughout the place of the Airavatas, uttered by the Nagas headed by Vasuki, O Janamejaya.

sa: ततः स भारनिष्पिष्टः क्षुधाविष्टश्च भारत॥ दृष्ट्वा तां वयसोऽवस्थां रुरोदार्तस्वरस्तदा।
en: Oppressed as he had been by that load and overcome by hunger, O Bharata, Utanka, secing that sign of old age, began to bewail a loud from excess of sorrow.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद। किं जष्यं जपतो नित्यं भवेद् धर्मफलं महत्॥
en: Yuthishthira said O grandfather, O you of great wisdom, O you who know all branches of knowledge, what is that subject of silent recitation by recititing which every day one may win the merit of virtue in a large measure?

sa: तथैव हि भवेयुस्ते लोकाः पापकृतो यथा। कृत्वा नाचक्षतः कर्म मम तच्च यथाकृतम्॥
en: Those regions that are reserved for the sinful shall be yours. What you had done, you did not tell me. That your sin was not known to any one, was your belief, and this conviction had filled you with joy.

sa: द्यौः सचन्द्रार्कनक्षत्रा खं दिशो भूर्महोदधिः। वासुदेवस्य वीर्येण विधृतानि महात्मनः॥
en: The sky with the sun, moon, and stars, the points of the compass, the Earth, and the Ocean, are all held and supported by the might of the great Vasudeva.

sa: आहुरेके च विद्वांसो ये ज्ञानपरिनिष्ठिताः। क्षेत्रज्ञसत्त्वयोरैक्यमित्येतन्नोपपद्यते॥
en: Some learned men that are devoted to knowledge hold that Kshetrajna and Nature are one. This, however, is not correct.

sa: तत्र दैवतकन्याभिरासनेनोपचर्यते॥ भूर्भुवं चापि देवर्षि विश्वरूपमवेक्षते।
en: There he is waited upon by celestial ladies and sees the celestial Rishi called Bhurbhuva and sees the entire universe.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि मुनिधर्ममनुत्तमम्। यं कृत्वा मुनयो यान्ति सिद्धिं स्वतपसा शुभे॥
en: The Blessed and Holy One said Yes, I shall recite to you the high and excellent Religion of the Ascetic. By following the dictates of that Religion, O auspicious lady, the Ascetics acquire success through the severe penances they practise.

sa: द्वौ मासौ तु भवेत्तृप्तिर्मत्स्यैः पितृगणस्य ह। त्रीन्मासानाविकेनाहुश्चतुर्मासं शशेन ह॥
en: With fishes offered at Shraddhas, the departed Manes remain pleased for two months. With mutton they remain pleased for three months and with the flesh of the hare for four.

sa: जग्राहाङ्गिरसं देवः शिखी तस्माद्हताशनः। तस्मादाङ्गिरसा ज्ञेयाः सर्व एव तदन्वयाः॥
en: After that the eater of sacrificial libations, viz., the god of fire, adopted of Angirasa. Hence, all the children of Angirasa are known as belonging to the race of Agni.

sa: देवानां प्रभवो देवो मनसश्च त्रिलोककृत्। अहमित्येव तत्सर्वमभिमन्ता स उच्यते॥
en: It is a deity, the creator of deities, and of mind. It is the which creates the three worlds. It is said to be that which feels-I am all this.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि स्पर्शास्त्वचि गताश्च ये। तस्मान्मे निर्जितो वायुर्वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: I do not wish for my own self those scrisations of touch which are in contact with even my skin. Therefore, the wind, subjugated by me, is always under me.

sa: क्रियावद्भिर्हि कौन्तेय देवलोकः समावृतः। . न चैतदिष्टं देवानां मर्त्यरूपनिवर्तनम्॥
en: The world of the celestials is filled, O son of Kunti, with those who follow the religion of actions. The cessation of the body is not liked by the celestials.

sa: अयं नारायणः श्रीमान् सर्वपार्थिवसम्मतः। भवन्तं बहुमानेन प्रश्रयेण च सेवते॥
en: This one is Narayana who is gifted with every prosperity and is honoured by all the kings. Even he waits upon you, showing you every indulgence and honoring you greatly.

sa: प्रदाता सर्वलोकानां विश्वं चाप्युच्यते महत्। ज्येष्ठभूतं वदन्त्येनं ब्राह्मणा ऋषयोऽपरे॥
en: These provide all worlds with the desired things. This huge universe has been told as their own appearance. Indeed, the Brahmanas and Rishis call him the eldest of all beings.

sa: एष गच्छति कौन्तेय तुरगश्चैव दीप्तिमान्। यमन्वेति महाबाहुः संस्पृशन् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: And they said, There goes the son of Kunti, are there that horse of burning beauty. Indeed, the mighty-armed hero follows the horse, having armed himself with his excellent bow.

sa: क्षयं नीतं कुलं दीप्तं पृथिवीराज्यमिच्छता। एतत् सर्वमनुस्मृत्य दह्यमानो दिवानिशम्॥
en: Desirous of getting the sovereignty of the Earth, he caused the Kuru race, blazing with prosperity, to be annihilated. Thinking of all this, I burn day and night with grief.

sa: प्रियाणि लभते नित्यं प्रियदः प्रियकृत् तथा। प्रियो भवति भूतानामिह चैव परत्र च॥
en: The man who makes gifts of agreeable things and who does to others what is agreeable to others, always succeeds in getting things that are agreeable to himself. Such a person certainly becomes agreeable to all, both here and hereafter.

sa: अवश्यं करणीयं च यद्येतन्मन्यसे विभो। तोयमिच्छामि यत्रेष्टं मरुष्वेतद्धि दुर्लभम्॥
en: I must accomplish that, O lord, which you think should be done! I wish to have water wherever my wish for it may arise. Water is scarce in such deserts!

sa: स त्वं न दुःखी दुःखस्य न सुखी सुसुखस्य च। स्मर्तुमिच्छसि कौन्तेय किमन्यद् दुःखविभ्रमात्॥ अथवा ते स्वभावोऽयं येन पार्थावकृष्यसे। दृष्ट्वा सभागतां कृष्णामेकवस्त्रां रजस्वलाम्। मिषतां पाण्डवेयानां न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥ प्रव्राजनं च नगरादजिनैश्च विवासनम्। महारण्यनिवासश्च न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥ जटासुरात् परिक्लेशश्चित्रसेनेन चाहवः। सैन्धवाच्च परिक्लेशो न तस्य स्मर्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: But you, O son of Kunti, do nether wish to recall your sorrows nor your happiness, what else do you wish to recall barring this delusion of sorrow. Or, perchance, O son of Pritha, it is your innate nature, by which you are at present overpowered. You do not wish to recall to your mind the painful spectacle of Krishna standing in the hall of assembly with only one piece of cloth to cover her body, and while she was in her menses and before all the Pandavas. And it is not proper that you should brood over your departure from the city, and your exile with the hide of the antelope for your dress, and your wanderings in the great forest, nor should you recall to your mind the affliction from Jatasura, the fight with Chitrasena, and your troubles from the Saindhavas.

sa: शास्त्रमार्गानुसारेण तद् विद्धि मनुजर्षभ। तत: सोऽन्तर्हितो बाहुः पितुर्मम जनाधिप॥
en: Know, O king, that what I did was perfectly consistent with the scriptural ordinance. After this, the arm of my father, O monarch, vanished, in our very sight. on more

sa: एवं रामाय कौरव्य वसिष्ठोऽकथयत् पुरा। तस्मात् सुवर्णदानाय प्रयतस्व नराधिप॥
en: Thus, O son of Kuru's race, did Vasishtha recite formerly this topic to Rama of Bhrigu's race. Do you, therefore, O king of men, try to make gifts of gold.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु महाबाहुः शरैररिनिघातिभिः। वारयामास तान् बाणांस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: The mighty-armed Arjuna baffled all those arrows with many foe-destroying arrows of his. The feat appeared to be exceedingly wonderful.

sa: साहं दुःखान्विता देवि पतिपुत्रविनाकृता। इहैव प्रायमाशिष्ये प्रेक्षन्त्यास्ते न संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, O reverend lady, afflicted as I am with grief and deprived as I am of both husband and son, I shall sit here today in Praya-vow before your presence.

sa: इहापि विषयः सर्वो यथादेहं प्रवर्तितः। मानुषाः स्थैर्यजाश्चैव पृथग्भोगा विशेषतः॥
en: In this condition every object of enjoyment exists for me according to the necessity of my body. Human beings and those creatures which originate from immobile objects have different enjoyments.

sa: कीट उवाच सर्वत्र निरतो जीव इतश्चापि सुखं मम। चिन्तयामि महाप्राज्ञ तस्मादिच्छामि जीवितुम्॥
en: The Worm said A living creature however circumstanced he may be becomes attached to it. In even this order of being I am happy, I think, O you of great wisdom! It is for this that I wish to live.

sa: ऊर्ध्व गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणसंयुक्ता यान्त्यधस्तामसा जनाः॥
en: They who abide in Goodness proceed upwards. They who abide in Darkness remain in the middle. They who abide in Ignorance being characterised by qualities that are low, sink downwards.

sa: कश्यप उवाच यत्पृथिव्यां व्रीहियवं हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः। सर्वं तन्नालमेकस्य तस्माद् विद्वाञ्छमं चरेत्॥
en: Kashyapa said All the paddy and barley on Earth, all the gold and animals and women that are in the world, are incapable of satisfying the desire of a single person. Hence, a wise man should, removing cupidity, adopt tranquillity.

sa: शापेन योजयामेति तथास्त्विति च साब्रवीत्। तदहं पितुरावेद्य प्रविश्य व्यथितेन्द्रिया॥
en: To this, the goddess Ganga readily agreed, saying, Be it so! Hearing these words I became very much distressed and penetrating into the nether regions represented everything to my father.

sa: निश्चित्य मनसा सर्वं गुणदोषबलाबलम्। दग्धुकामः कुलं सर्वं कुशिकानां तपोधनः॥
en: Reflecting upon the merits and faults of that incident, as also its strength and weakness, Chyavana having asceticism for his wealth, became desirous of consuming the race of the Kushikas.

sa: उपच्छन्नं प्रकाशं वा वृत्त्या प्रतिपालयेत् राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां श्रेयस्तत् क्षत्रियान् प्रति॥
en: Covertly or publicly, do you maintain such Brahmanas by giving to them the means of support. Such conduct always gives higher benefit to Kshatriyas than the Rajasuya and the Horse-Sacrifices.

sa: तस्मात् समन्तपञ्चकमितो याम द्रुतं नृप। प्रथितोत्तरवेदी सा देवलोके प्रजापतेः॥
en: I shall for this, O king, speedily proceed to Samantapancka. In the celestial region that spot is known as the northern (sacrificial) altar of Brahman, the Lord of all creatures.

sa: अत्युग्रप्रतिपिष्टैश्च नदद्भिश्त भृशोत्कटैः। गजाश्वमथितैश्चान्यैर्मही कीर्णाभवत् प्रभो॥
en: The Earth, O lord, was soon strewn with human beings that were disfigured or trampled down by elephants and horses.

sa: ब्रूहि धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठ परं कौतूहलं मम। मोक्षधर्मार्थकुशलो भवाँल्लोकेषु गीयते॥
en: Do you answer them, o foremost of all persons knowing duties! My curiosity is great. you are celebrated in all the worlds as one well-skilled in the duties about liberation.

sa: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यः प्रव्रजेद् द्विजः। लोकास्तेजोमयास्तस्य प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: That twice-born one who enters the fourth mode of life, giving pledges of assurance to all creatures, succeeds in acquiring many effulgent regions hereafter and ultimately attains to the Infinite.

sa: ऋजोर्मदोर्वदान्यस्य ह्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः। नान्यो ज्ञातेर्महाबाहो विनाशमभिनन्दति॥
en: None but a kinsman feels joy at the destruction of a kinsman endued with sincerity, mildness, liberality, modesty and truthfulness.

sa: प्रसादयामास मनस्तेन रुद्रस्य भारत। प्रीतश्चापि महादेवश्चकार वृषभं तदा॥ ध्वजं च वाहनं चैव तस्मात् स वृषभध्वजः।
en: Daksha pleased Rudra, O Bharata, with that present. Mahadeva, thus pleased, made that bull his career, And it was after the form of that bull that Mahadeva adopted the emblem on the standard floating on his battlecar. Therefore it is that Rudra came to be known as the bullbannered deity.

sa: सन्नद्धा धन्विनः सर्वे प्राद्रवन् नरपुङ्गवाः। ब्राह्मणार्थे यतन्तस्ते शीघ्रमन्वगमन् मृगम्॥
en: Taking great care for the sake of the Brahmana, all those foremost of men, taking up their bows and doing their corslets speedily went out in pursuit of the deer.

sa: नाडीजङ्घ इति ख्यातो दयितो ब्रह्मणः सखा। बकराजो महाप्राज्ञः कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवः॥
en: His name was Nadijangha and he was a great friend of the Creator. He was a prince of Cranes; endued with great wisdom, and a son of (the sage) Kashyapa.

sa: ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव तं पार्थो ववर्ष शरवृष्टिभिः। तदस्त्रमस्त्रेणावार्य प्रजहार च पाण्डवः॥
en: Partha, also, by his Brahma weapon made a down pour of upon Karna. Counteracting the arrows of his enemy with those of his own Pandu's son continued to strike him.

sa: कर्मणा वै पुरा देवा ऋषयश्चामितौजसः। त्राता: सर्वं प्रसह्यारीन्क्षत्रधर्मेण विष्णुना॥
en: In days of yore Vishnu, by acting according to Kshatriya duties, forcibly suppressed and killed his enemies. Accordingly he have relief to the gods and the Rishis of immeasurable power.

sa: नियच्छन्ति परां बुद्धिं शिष्टाचारान्विता जनाः। उपाध्यायमते युक्ताः स्थित्या धर्मार्थदर्शिनः॥
en: They, who are endued with the virtuous behaviours; they, who follow the orders of the preceptors; and they, who minutely observe the import of the scriptures, obtain the highest intelligence.

sa: तस्यार्थेऽपत्यमीहेत येन न्यायेन शक्नुयात्। न तस्मान्मन्त्रवत्कार्यं कश्चित् कुर्वीत किंचन॥
en: She may even raise children for the giver by any of those means that are laid down in the scriptures. No person, however, can marry her according to due rites.

sa: परायणं देवमूर्धा क्रतुभिर्मधुसूदन। अयजो भूरितेजा वै कृष्ण चैत्ररथे वने॥
en: O slayer of Madhu, O greatly effulgent one, O Krishna, you gratified with your sacrifice in the forest of Chitraratha the chief of the celestials, the highest of the high.

sa: घातयिष्याम नृपतिं पाञ्चालं सशिखण्डिनम्॥ तत् तदाऽनृतमाज्ञाय पुनर्वृतान्नराधिपः। प्रास्थापयत् पार्षताय निहन्मीति स्थिरो भव॥
en: We will slay thịś king of the Panchalas along with Shikhandin. Knowing this to be the fixed resolve the king (Hiranyavarman) once more sent messengers to the son of Prishata, (with the message). “I shall slay you, wait a little."

sa: एते सप्तविधात्मानो नानावीर्याः पृथक् पृथक्। नाशक्नुवन् प्रजाः स्रष्टुमसमागम्य कृत्स्नशः॥
en: These seven kinds of entities, possessing various kinds of energy, at first existed separately from one another. They could not create objects without all of them acting in a body.

sa: न्यायागतं धनं चैव न्यायेनैव विवर्धितम्। संरक्ष्यं यत्नमास्थाय धर्मार्थमिति निश्चयः॥
en: to That wealth is gained by fair means and is multiplied by fair means, should be protected with care for the sake of acquiring virtue. This is an accepted truth.

sa: दीपादन्ये यथा दीपाः प्रवर्तन्ते सहस्रशः। प्रकृतिः सूयते तद्वदानन्त्यान् नापचीयते॥
en: From one lighted lamp thousands of other lamps are capable of being lighted. Similarly, Prakriti produces thousands of existent things. On account of its infinity, primordial matter is never exhausted,

sa: यथाव॒तुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये। दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु॥
en: As the various phenomena of the several seasons set in one after another according to the season that comes, so creatures come into being at the commencement of every cycle.

sa: अन्तर्भेदे च संजाते दुःखं संस्मृत्य च प्रभो। अभूतपूर्वो बीभत्सोर्दुःखान्मन्युरजायत॥
en: And agitated at heart and remembering all his former woes, O lord, Vibhatsu was possessed by an anger engendered of brief, the like of which had never possessed him before.

sa: ये केचन गतास्तस्य समीपमपलायिनः। न ते प्रतिन्यवर्तन्त समुद्रादिव सिन्धवः॥
en: Just as rivers never course back from the ocean they fall in, so no one among them who did not fly, returned back with his life, after having encountered Abhimanyu.

sa: अनूष्मणामचेष्टानां घनानां चैव तत्त्वतः। वृक्षाणां नोपलभ्यन्ते शरीरे पञ्च धातवः॥
en: Trees do not appear to have possessed any heat. They appear to have no motion. They are again formed of thick particles. The five elements are not seen in them.

sa: सौऽभिमन्यु त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विद्ध्वा वक्षस्यथानदत्। त्रिभिश्च दक्षिणे बाहौ सव्ये च निशितैस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Piercing Abhimanyu on the breast with three shafts, he uttered his war-cry; and then again, he pierced him on the right and the left arms with three sharp shafts each.

sa: त्वं पुनः कारणैनं रक्ष्यसे शाल्मले यथा। वायुना सपरीवारस्तेन तिष्ठस्यसंशयम्॥
en: Forsooth, you stand here with all your branches and twigs and leaves, simply because, O Shalmali, you are protected by the Wind for some reason or reasons (unknown to us)!

sa: स समं धर्मकामार्थान् सिषेवे भरतर्षभ। त्रीनिवात्मसमान् बन्धून नीतिमानिव मानयन्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, he (Yudhishthira) served equally Dharma, Artha and Kama, as if each of them was a friend as dear to him as his own soul.

sa: अनुगच्छंश्च तुरगं निवृत्तोऽथ किरीटभृत्। यदृच्छया समापेदे पुरं राजगृहं तदा॥
en: Following as he did that horse, the diademdecked Arjuna also turned his face towards the Kuru capital. Wandering at is will, the horse then came to the city of Rajagriha.

sa: काश्चित् प्रहृष्टा ननृतुश्चक्रुशुश्च तथापराः। जगुश्चान्या वरस्त्रियः॥
en: Some amongst them danced in joy and some began to sing; some laughed and jested and some drank excellent wines.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रयान्तं देवकीपुत्रं परवीररुजो दश। महारथा महाबाहुमन्वयुः शस्त्रपाणयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Ten mighty car-warriors capable of vanquishing heroes on the enemy's side with arms in their hands followed the son of Devaki of long arms as he proceeded along.

sa: अथ तत्रापि चान्योऽस्य भूयो जात उपद्रवः॥ कूपमध्ये महानागमपश्यत महाबलम्।
en: While in that state, he was visited by various other calamities. He saw a large and mighty snake within the pit. He also saw a gigantic elephant near its mouth.

sa: जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा दिव्याभरणभूषितम्। पीतकौशेयवसनं हेम्नेवोपगतं मणिम्॥
en: Clad in yellow silk robes and adorned with celestial ornaments, his person shone effulgent like a jewel set on gold.

sa: इतिनागा मया ब्रह्मन्कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः। प्राधान्येन बहुत्वात्तु न सर्वे परिकीर्तिताः॥
en: O Brahmana, thus have I recited the names of the chief snakes, all famous for their great deeds. I have not been able to mention all, their number being countless.

sa: अवध्यमानः सोऽभयनन्मागधः पाण्डवर्षभम्। तेन तस्थौ य कौरव्य लोकवीरस्य दर्शने॥
en: Arjuna had no desire of killing the king of Magadha. It was for this that, having struck the son of Pandu, he succeeded in remaining before that foremost of heroes.

sa: दुर्बलस्य च यच्चक्षुर्मुनेराशीविषस्य च। अविषह्यतमं मन्ये मा स्म दुर्बलमासदः॥
en: The eyes of the Weak, of the Muni, and of the venomous snake, should be considered as unbearable. Do not, therefore, meet the Weak as you would do an enemy.

sa: भवितव्यं तथा तच्च दिष्टमेतन्महात्मनाम्॥ उपेक्षितं च कृष्णेन शक्तेनापि व्यपोहितुम्।
en: That which has taken place, had been ordained. It was the destiny of those great warriors. Krishna allowed it to take place although he was fully competent to befell it.

sa: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धौ प्रेक्षमाणावरिंदमौ॥ उभौ भरतशार्दूलौ विक्रमेण समन्वितौ।
en: Those two chastisers of foes looked angrily upon each other. Both were foremost of Bharata's race, endued with great prowess.

sa: शुशुभे राजमध्यस्थो नीलवासाः सितप्रभः। नक्षत्रैरिव सम्पूर्णो वृतो निशि निशाकरः॥
en: In the midst of those kings, Baladeva clad in blue raiment and possessed of a fair complexion shone like the full moon surrounded in the night by thousands of stars.

sa: ततः प्रहस्ताधिरथिर्विधुन्वानः स कार्मुकम्। भित्वा भल्लेन राजानं विद्ध्वा षष्टयाऽनदत्तदा॥
en: Then laughing and shaking his bow the son of Adhiratha wounded the king's body with a Bhalla, then pierce him with sixty arrows and then sent up a loud war-cry.

sa: वाक्सायका वदनानिष्पतन्ति यैराहतः शोचति रात्र्यहानि। परस्य नामर्मसु ते पतन्ति तान्पण्डितो नावसृजेत् परेषु॥
en: Wordy arrows fall from the lips. Pierced therewith one burns always. Those arrows do not cut any other part than the very vitals of the person aimed. Hence he who is a learned man, should never aim them at others.

sa: विक्रीडितं कुमारेण यथानीकं बिभित्सता। आरुग्णाश्च यथा वीरा दुःसाध्याश्चापि विप्लवे॥
en: I shall tell you, how that hero played amidst us, having penetrated into our ranks; as also how, many irresistible heroes inspired with hopes of victory were afflicted by him.

sa: भार्यार्थं तां च जग्राह पार्थः कामवशानुगाम्। एवमेष समुत्पन्नः परपक्षेऽर्जुनात्मजः॥
en: As she came to him under the influence of desire, the son of Pritha accepted her as his wife. Thus it was that Arjuna's son was begotten upon another's wife.

sa: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति। स्थित्वास्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति॥
en: This is, O Partha, living in Self (God). After attaining it, no delusion exists; and remaining in this state at the time of one's death, one attains to Brahma Nirvana.

sa: देवासुराणां सर्वेषां श्वेतपर्वत उच्यते। गन्धर्वा निषधे नित्यं नीले ब्रह्मपर्यस्तथा।।
en: The Shveta mountain is said to be the abode of the celestial and celestial and the Asuras. The Gandharvas live on the Nishadha and the Brahmana Rishis on the Nila.

sa: अनूपाधिपतिः शूरो भीमस्य दयितः सखा। नालो नीलाम्बुदप्रख्यः संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिमभ्ययात्॥
en: The heroic ruler of the low countries, that dear-loved friend of Bhima, by name Nila, of complexion blue like the clouds, excited with wrath, rushed at the son of Drona.

sa: पञ्चालराजं द्रुपदं दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। ततः काम्पिल्यमासाद्य दशार्णाधिपतिस्ततः॥
en: Drupada the king of the Panchalas, being filled with grief and sorrow. Thereupon having reaching Kampilya, the lord of Dasharna,

sa: अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। भीमसेनस्तु राजानं मुहूर्तादिव बाह्निकम्॥
en: Bhimasena in a moment deprived king Balhika of his horses, car and driver, before the very eyes of the troops.

sa: राक्षसश्च महाकायः स च राजाऽतिकोपनः। एतौ समेतौ समरे कालमृत्युसमावुभौ॥
en: This Rakshasa is of prodigious stature, and king Bhagadatta also is very wrathful. Surely encountering each other in the fight they both will prove like the Death and the Destroyer.

sa: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः। आत्मन्येव च संतुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते॥
en: But the man, who is attached to his own Self, who is pleased with his own Self, and who is contented with his own Self, has no actions to perform.

sa: आत्मा रक्ष्यो रणे तात सर्वावस्थास्वरिंदम। धर्मराजेन संग्रामस्त्वया कार्यः सदाऽनघ॥
en: O sire, O slayer of foes, you should ever carefully protect yourself in battle, under all circumstances. O sinless one, you should always engage with the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

sa: तस्य नानदतः केतुमुच्चकर्त च कार्मुकम्। क्षुराभ्यां पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठस्तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥
en: But while the former was still roaring, with two razor sharp arrows, the foremost of the Pandavas severed his bow and banner. At this the warriors shouted forth (in joy).

sa: तद् युद्धमभवद् घोरं वृद्धयोः सह सेनयोः। यथा महायूथपयोपियाः सम्प्रभिन्नयोः॥
en: Thereat between those two old supported by their respective army, a fierce encounter raged. Which resembled that between two mighty leaders, with rent temples, of two different herds of elephants.

sa: सर्वेषामेष वै पन्थाः शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। क्षत्रियाणां विशेषेण येषां युद्धेन जीविका॥
en: This indeed is the inevitable fate of all those heroes who never think of retreating. Specially of the Kshatriyas who live by war. Of unretreating heroes fighting in battle, this.

sa: ऊर्ध्वगच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः॥
en: Those that live in Sattva go on high those that are addicted to Raja live in the middle; and those that are of Tama, having the lowest quality, go down.

sa: ततः सूतव्यसनिनं मां स भार्गवः। शरेणाभ्यहनन् गाढं विकृष्य बलवद्धनुः॥
en: Then did that scion of the Bhrigu race having drawn up his bow with great force hurtle an arrow at me who was overwhelmed at the calamity of my charioteer.

sa: दानवं घोरकर्माणं गवां मृत्युमिवोत्थितम्। वृषरूपधरं बाल्ये भुजाभ्यां निजधान ह॥
en: In his early years, he killed with his two arms only, the Danava in the form of a bull, of terrible deeds and born as Death himself to the COWS.

sa: सौभं दैत्यपुरं खस्थं शाल्वगुप्तं दुरासदम्। समुद्रकुक्षौ विक्रम्य पातयामास माधवः॥
en: Madhava, by his prowess, hurled into the bosomn of the sea, the fortress of the Danavas known as Soubha, situated in heaven, protected by Shalva and considered to be invulnerable.

sa: उक्त्वा भीष्मवधायेति प्रविवेश हुताशनम्। ज्येष्ठा काशिसुता राजन् यमुनामभितो नदीम्॥
en: That eldest daughter of the king of Kashi, O king, entered the fire on the banks of the river Yamuna, saying (as she did so) “For the destruction of Bhimasena.

sa: इत्येवमुच्चरन्ति स्म श्रूयन्ते विविधा गिरः। नरस्याश्वस्य नागस्य समसज्जत शोणितम्॥
en: The blood of men and steeds and elephants mingled together, flowed in one current and caused the Earth's dust to disappear and inspired terror into the hearts of the cowards.

sa: स पर्वतो महाराज दिव्यपुष्पफलान्वितः। भवनैरावृतः सर्वैर्जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृतैः॥
en: O king, that mountain possesses celestial fruits and flowers; it is covered all over with houses made of burnished gold.

sa: सोऽहमिच्छाम्यनुज्ञातुं रक्षितुं वा महात्मना। द्रोणेन सहपुत्रेण वीरेण यदि मन्यसे॥
en: So, may it please you, I desire to have either your permission to go home or to be protected by the high-souled Drona and his son, both endued with heroism."

sa: शृरं शिखण्डिनः पुत्रमृक्षदेवमुदावहन्। रुक्मभाण्डप्रतिच्छन्नाः कौशेयसदृशा हयाः॥
en: Bore the heroic son of Sikhandin viz., Kshatradeva, decorated with caparison of gold and of the hue of silk, steeds.

sa: षष्ट्या शराणां तं द्रौणिस्मिग्मधारैः सुतेजनैः। उौर्नाकम्पयद् विद्ध्वा मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: Then Drona's having pierced Abhimanyu with sixty fierce and resplendent shafts of exceeding sharpness, could not make the latter tremble; and then the latter remained unmoved like the Mainaka hills.

sa: ततश्चक्रोध बलवांश्चक्रे वेगं च संयुगे। आर्थ्यशृङ्गिस्तथा दृष्ट्वा समरे शत्रुमूर्जितम्॥
en: Thereafter that of Rishyashringa possessed of great strength, beholding his puissant antagonist blaze forth in that battle, became inflamed with fury and put forth his own powers in that battle.

sa: क्रुद्धश्च चापमायम्य बलवद् बलिनां वरः। कालिङ्गमवधीत् पार्थो भीमः सप्तभिरायसैः॥
en: Then that foremost of powerful men, that son of Pritha, Bhima in great anger drew his bow to its highest stretch, and killed the Kalinga king with seven iron arrows.

sa: अग्रहील्लक्षणं स्त्रीणां स्त्रीभूतो तिष्ठते गृहे। नोपसर्पति तेनासौ सब्रीडः स्त्रीसरूपवान्॥
en: Having taken her womanhood (on himself) he remains in this abode, being a woman. He does not approach (you), bashful on account of her holding the form of a woman.

sa: एते प्राधान्यतो राजन् पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। स्थाश्चातिस्थाश्चैव ये चान्येऽर्धरथा नृप॥
en: The great souled ones are the chief Rathas, and Atirathas, O king, on the side of the Pandava and these others are only half a Ratha, O ruler of men.

sa: अपक्रान्तास्तुमुले सम्प्रमर्दे सुदारुणे भारत मोहनीये। अमूढचेतास्त्वथ चित्रसेनो महागदामापतन्तीं निरीक्ष्य॥
en: Fled in all directions, in that confounding dreadful and ruthless crush of combatants. O Bharata, your son Chitrasena beholding that mighty mace course towards him, was not confounded at heart.

sa: तं क्रुद्धं प्रतिविव्याध प्रतिविन्ध्यः शितैः शरैः। सिंहलाङ्गललक्ष्माणं पितुरर्थे व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Wrought up with rage, Prativindhya with whetted shafts pierced him who bore the device of the lion's tail in his banner and who was anxious to serve his father's interests.

sa: त्रि:सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवीं कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां प्रभुः। इष्ट्वा क्रतुशतैर्वीरो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत॥
en: That lord, that hero having relieved the earth, for twenty-one times, of her burdens of the Kshatriya population and having celebrated a hundred sacrifices, gave her away to the Brahmanas.

sa: विनिर्भिन्नाः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैनिपेतुर्वसुधातले। शरातुरास्तथैवान्ये दन्तियो विद्रुता दिशः॥
en: Mangled with his shafts, fell down on the surface of the earth. Huge-tusked elephants afflicted with arrow-wounds in all directions.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गीता सुगीता कर्तव्या किमन्यैः शास्त्रसंग्रहैः। या स्वयं पद्मनाभस्य मुखपद्माद् विनिःसृता॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejaya! What is the need to collect a pile of scriptures? Gita should be duly listened, recited, read, taught, understood and retained properly as it has emanated directly from the lotus lips of god Padmanabha himself.

sa: आद्रवन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसं युद्धदुर्मदम्। इरावानथ संरब्धः प्रत्यधावन्महाबलः॥
en: Seeing that Rakshasa invincible in battle make towards himself, the highly puissant Iravat, exited with wrath, began to resist him;

sa: यो धारयति लोकांस्त्रींश्चराचरगुरुः प्रभुः। योद्धा जयश्च जेता च सर्वप्रकृतिरीश्वरः॥
en: That preceptor of the mobile and the immobile creations, that supreme Lord supports the triune world; he is the Warrior the Victory, the Victorious, and the Lord of all nature.

sa: माण्डव्यस्याश्रमे राजन् दिलीपस्याश्रमे तथा। रामहदे च कौरव्य पैलगर्गस्य चाश्रमे॥
en: And to the hermitage of Mandvya O king, as also to the hermitage of Dilipa to the (sacred) water of Rama's lake, O Kauravya, and to the hermitage of Pailagarga,

sa: हतमेव हि पश्यामि गाङ्गेयं पितरं रणे। वासुदेवसहायेन पार्थेन दृढधन्वना॥
en: I already see my father, the son of Ganga, slain in battle by the son of Pritha who has a firm grasp on his bow, having Vasudeva for his help-mate.

sa: रथं चान्यैः सुबहुभिश्चक्रे विशकलं शरैः। सुदक्षिणं तं काम्बोजं मोघसंकल्पविक्रमम्॥ बिभेद हदि बाणेन पृथुधारेण पाण्डवः। स भिन्नवर्मा स्रस्ताङ्ग प्रभ्रष्टमुकुटाङ्गदः॥
en: And with innumerable other arrows he rendered the latter's chariot useless and cut it to pieces. The son of Pandu then with an arrow of exceeding sharpness pierced on the chest Sudakshina the Kamboja ruler whose purpose and prowess had both even baffled. Then with his armour shattered, trembling in all his limbs, with his crown and Angadas falling off.

sa: ततो मद्राधिपं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्राः पराङ्मुखम्। सनागपत्त्यश्वरथाः समकम्पन्त मारिष॥
en: Thereupon your sons-seeing the king of the Madras turn back from the field of battle, O Sire, began to tremble supported though they were by elephant, infantry, cavalry and cars.

sa: पार्थस्तु प्रहसन् धीमानाचार्यं सशरौघिणम्। विसृजन्तं शितान् बाणानवारयत तं युधि॥
en: The highly intelligent son of Pritha then smiling the while, checked the preceptor in battle who incessantly shooting sharp arrows, was looking like a sea having shafts or its waves.

sa: यन्त्रैश्च बहुधाच्छिन्नस्तोमरैश्चापि काञ्चनैः। अश्वानां रेणुकपिलै रुक्मच्छन्नैरुरश्छदैः॥
en: With many broken implements of war, with golden dares, with many gold fringed breast plates of steeds soiled with dust,

sa: ततः पुरुषशार्दूलः सज्जं सज्जपुरःसरः। कृताह्निकाय पार्थाय न्यवेदत तं रथम्॥
en: Thereafter that foremost of men, namely the son of Vasudeva eased in an armour, told Pritha's son who had completed his morning prayers that his chariot had been made ready.

sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः॥
en: Fix your mind on Me, become My worshipper, become My devotee, bow to Me. Thus making Me your goal, and devoting yourself to obstruction, you will certainly come to Me.
